Terrible Experience — Extremely Disappointed

This was one of the most disappointing pet grooming experiences I have ever had. I asked twice before the appointment how much the grooming would cost, and I was never given a clear price. In my opinion, a professional grooming business should be completely transparent about pricing before performing the service, not after the dog is already groomed.

Unfortunately, the grooming itself was just as disappointing. The haircut was poorly done, uneven, and far below the quality I expected. I was shocked by the final result and extremely unhappy with how my dog looked. The quality of the grooming absolutely did not justify what I was charged.

What made the experience even worse was the price. I was charged far more than I expected for a standard grooming, even though I had specifically asked about the cost beforehand and was never given an answer. That lack of communication made the entire situation feel very unfair and frustrating.

To make matters worse, there was an expectation of a tip after I had already paid a significant amount for a service I was extremely unhappy with. A tip should reflect good service—it should never feel expected, especially when the customer is clearly dissatisfied with the results.

I have had my dog groomed before and know what a good grooming job should look like. This experience was nowhere close to that standard. Poor communication, no price transparency, disappointing grooming quality, and an unreasonable charge made this an experience I would not want to repeat.

I sincerely regret choosing this groomer and would not recommend this business to other pet owners. If you are considering using them, I strongly recommend getting the complete price in writing before leaving your dog so you are not surprised afterward.

We recently had to find a new groomer after using the same one for over 20 years, so we decided to try this mobile grooming service based on the great reviews.

Unfortunately, our experience wasn’t what we had hoped for. I asked for a regular bichonpoo haircut with just a little trimmed off the body and face. Instead, after only about 10 minutes, our dog was completely shaved, which was not what I had requested.

Our second dog, a schnauzer, turned out much better overall. However, her eyelashes were cut off and her face was trimmed much shorter than expected. The groomer explained that her face was heavily matted, but we’ve had our schnauzer for 11 years and have never had a groomer tell us her face was matted—only her chest has ever been prone to matting. If you’re familiar with schnauzers, you know their eyelashes are typically left intact as part of the breed’s signature look.

My biggest disappointment was the communication. When I explained that our bichonpoo wasn’t supposed to be shaved, there seemed to be a misunderstanding about what I had requested, even after I showed a reference photo of the style I wanted. We also never received the live camera link we were told we would get.

They did offer a small discount, which we appreciated, but unfortunately the overall experience didn’t meet our expectations. I hope this feedback helps improve communication with future clients.

EDIT 07/02/26: DEFINITELY DO NOT GO HERE!!! This company read my review and reached out and tried to bribe me with changing my review to 4 stars for a 50% refund. ABSOLUTELY NOT!!! And after I said I would like the 1/2 refund they made me sign a waiver then said I need to change my review. Then when I said no they continued to text me over and over again . So I unsubscribed. No joke 20min later I received another text from a different number harassing me over and over again bribing me to change my review for full refund now. I will not change my review. How are they going to text me and have me sign a waiver to give consent for a refund, then tell me they WILL ONLY GIVE ME A REFUND IF I CHANGE MY REVIEW!!

How can anyone be sure that these reviews are authentic and not bribed to edit. DO NOT GO HERE!!

This correspondence serves as a formal notice regarding an unacceptable lapse in professionalism and service.

I brought my dog nova in for grooming, and while the groomer was patient, the overall experience was disappointing and ended up causing more harm than good. within a day of the appointment, nova developed a severe reaction on her face bumps, redness, burning, and scabbing that lasted several days. she was crying the next morning from how irritated her skin was.

i’m not sure what products were used on her face, but clearly something wasn’t appropriate for a sensitive-skin dog. as pet owners, we trust groomers to use safe, gentle products, especially when we mention a dog’s sensitivities.

communication before the appointment also wasn’t great i asked multiple questions and mostly got price quotes back without the details i actually needed.

i wanted to share my honest experience because i feel like it’s important for dog owners with sensitive skin dogs to know what to expect. i scheduled a grooming appointment for my staffie, nova, and while the groomer himself was patient with her, the overall experience left me disappointed.

first, the communication before the appointment felt rushed and very price driven. when i asked about timing and availability, the responses were unclear and focused mainly on what the service cost, instead of answering simple questions about when they could actually come. as a customer, that didn’t feel good it felt like payment mattered more than the dog.

the bigger issue happened after the grooming. within a day, nova developed bumps and irritation all over her face. she woke up crying in the middle of the night, and she wasn’t herself for several days. she didn’t even enjoy her car rides something she loves more than anything. the reaction was painful and stressful for her, and it was hard for me to watch.

she’s finally starting to heal, but the whole situation was rough. i don’t know what product was used on her face, but whatever it was, it caused a noticeable reaction. i really think the team needs to be more careful with products, especially around the face, and more aware of how certain shampoos, sprays, or wipes can affect sensitive dogs.

I appreciate that they eventually apologized and documented her sensitivity for future visits, but i still feel this could have been avoided with better communication and more attention to detail. i hope this review helps them improve their process going forward, because our pets deserve the best care and safest products possible.
